description: Defines the MediaWriter class interface for media writing operations in Android's stagefright media framework, including methods for managing media sources, file size/duration limits, and event notifications.

classes.name: MediaWriter
classes.description: An abstract class providing interface for media writing, including source addition, control operations, and event notification.

methods.name: isFdOpenModeValid
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor is in a valid open mode for media writing.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source to the writer.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts media writing with optional parameters.

methods.name: setCaptureRate
methods.description: Sets the capture frame rate; unsupported in base implementation.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the media recorder client listener.

methods.name: setStartTimeOffsetMs
methods.description: Sets start time offset in milliseconds.

methods.name: getStartTimeOffsetMs
methods.description: Gets start time offset in milliseconds.

methods.name: setNextFd
methods.description: Sets the next file descriptor for output.
